outcome: Give farm operations director / food quality head a governed method to improve yield forecast error by block using orchard imagery, ground sampling and harvest history, with final decisions retained…
overview: Orchard Yield Estimation from Drone Data addresses teams rely on lagging aggregates when forecasts or decisions depend on changing operational conditions in agriculture and food production operations. The first proof of value uses orchard imagery, ground sampling and harvest history. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is yield forecast error by block, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: orchard imagery, ground sampling and harvest history; define yield forecast error by block and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Farm Operations Director / Food Quality Head.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including backtest across seasonal and peak periods with a holdout cohort.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
